title: Redwood May 2026 All-Hands - Leadership Update
summary: Leadership gave a Q2 progress update: bookings slightly ahead of plan, product shipped key Dedicated autoscaling improvements, Private deployment pilot kicked off with two customers, infra team showed 12% median latency improvement via new batching and kernel selections. Hiring is focused on SRE and enterprise sales; security team completed a SOC 2 readiness run and will share docs. Deck and OKRs to be shared; follow-ups include scheduling product deep dives and running external benchmarks.
transcript:
Header:
Date: 2026-05-06
Time: 10:00 AM PT
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Maya Chen (CEO), Rahul Singh (CTO), Lina Gomez (Head of Product), Marcus Lee (Head of Sales), Priya Kapoor (Head of People Ops), Elena Park (VP Engineering), plus all employees (via livestream)

[00:00] Maya Chen: hey everyone, thanks for joining our May all hands, um, quick note — recording is on, slides are up, we'll keep this to about an hour and leave 10 minutes for q and a.
[00:23] Rahul Singh: good morning all, quick infra update — we've rolled out the new kernel selector to staging last week, and initial results look promising, about a 12 percent median latency improvement for 8k seq benches, uh, with some variance.
[00:45] Elena Park: yeah, to add, the continuous batching changes helped a lot on tail p90s too, though we're still tuning burst policy. There's a tradeoff on cost, obviously, when we increase batching windows.
[01:10] Lina Gomez: product update — Redwood Dedicated got autoscale policies that respect reserved pools; customers can define burst quotas now. We also shipped a new dashboard view in Redwood Console for per-route token costs. Note, some of the labels on the dashboard got scrambled in the build, working on that.
[01:42] Marcus Lee: on the sales front, we're ahead of plan by about 8 percent in bookings for Q2 — pipeline is healthy, big enterprise deals pushing towards Dedicated and Private pilots. Two notable pilots: one in fintech and one in healthcare — both require strict data residency and on-prem options.
[02:10] Priya Kapoor: hiring update — we're opening 6 SRE roles and 4 senior account exec roles. Interview loop is being standardized; try to keep interview cycles under three weeks.
[02:32] Maya Chen: finance quick take — burn is in-line with plan, runway extended slightly with the Series C reserve; we are still prioritizing product spend on Private and reliability.
[02:50] Rahul Singh: security — SOC 2 readiness run complete; we found a few gaps around key rotation and audit log retention. Elena's team is working with security to push fixes; expect a public security pack by end of month.
[03:10] Elena Park: small note on KMS integration — we've validated HSM flows with our staging KMS provider but saw token refresh errors in long-running connections, likely a retry bug.
[03:40] Maya Chen: ok, let's go through 3 quick customer stories — Marcus?
[03:45] Marcus Lee: sure — customer A (fintech) asked about VPC and private control plane latency, they're worried about cold-start on large models. We suggested Dedicated with warm pools and KV cache prewarm. Customer B (healthcare) wants an air-gapped on-prem eval; legal is reviewing our compliance docs.
[04:20] Lina Gomez: on model roadmap — we are prioritizing quantization profiles and verified model variants for common enterprise workloads; Redwood Optimize will include baseline suggestions per workload in next release.
[04:45] Rahul Singh: technical note — kernel selection is heuristic-based; we patched an edge case where attention math threw a fallback path that increased cost. That patch is in canary.
[05:10] Audience Q (via Slack): will we support newer A100-like memory configs?
[05:15] Elena Park: yes, we're working on memory-optimized kernels; timeline is Q3 for general availability.
[05:30] Maya Chen: culture and org — shout out to product and infra for the late Q1/Q2 push; also, hiring is top priority to keep momentum. Priya?
[05:45] Priya Kapoor: thanks — folks, please complete your Q2 growth calibration by next Friday; also we're rolling out a flexible PTO pilot for the summer.
[06:05] Maya Chen: ok, open floor for a few more questions —
[06:12] Employee (unlabeled): hi — any updates on marketplace integrations?
[06:15] Marcus Lee: marketplace is on the roadmap for H2; we'll prioritize after a small set of enterprise integrations are complete, like Azure and GCP partner listing.
[06:40] Employee: question on pricing — will we grandfather older pricing for Dedicated?
[06:45] Marcus Lee: we'll offer a limited grandfathering window for existing customers but new contracts will follow the updated tiered pricing model.
[07:05] Employee: security docs — when will they be public?
[07:07] Rahul Singh: plan is end of May for a security pack, includes SOC 2 roadmap, audit log examples, and SSO/SAML setup notes.
[07:30] Maya Chen: let's do a quick recap and next steps —
[07:35] Lina Gomez: product will share the Q2 roadmap deck and a separate deep dive invite for Redwood Dedicated features.
[07:50] Rahul Singh: infra will run a public benchmark for kernel selector vs. baseline and share results.
[08:00] Marcus Lee: sales will circulate list of pilot customers and ask for SE availability for technical calls.
[08:10] Priya Kapoor: people ops will share updated interview guides and the flexible PTO pilot doc.
[08:20] Maya Chen: thanks everyone, big thanks to the infra and product teams — keep shipping, and please fill the survey after this call.

[Q&A portion - approximate timestamps continue every 30-60s, some crosstalk and filler words omitted] 
[55:00] End of recording.
action_items: Rahul - Run and publish external latency and cost benchmarks for kernel selector by 2026-05-20
Lina - Share Q2 product roadmap deck and schedule Redwood Dedicated deep-dive (invite by 2026-05-10)
Elena - Fix KMS token refresh retry bug in staging and report status by 2026-05-18
Marcus - Circulate pilot customer list and coordinate SE support for calls by 2026-05-09
Priya - Share updated interview guides and PTO pilot doc by 2026-05-12
Security Team - Publish SOC 2 readiness pack and audit log examples by 2026-05-28
